title: Velero / Backups
description: Curated backup view: is the last backup of each schedule fresh and successful, is the R2 bucket reachable, did the node-agent (Kopia) copy the volumes, is repository maintenance healthy. Metrics from Velero v1.18.2 (https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero/blob/v1.18.2/pkg/metrics/metrics.go), panels follow the Velero project's grafana.com dashboard 16829 and the alerts in this repo. Full upstream view: 'Velero / Official'.

list.name: Backups failed
list.textFormat: a backup of schedule {{schedule}} failed or partially failed

panels.title: How to read this dashboard
panels.description: Reading guide for this dashboard.

options.content:
**What Velero does here.** Schedule `velero-daily` (03:00 UTC, TTL 30 days) backs up the namespaces `vault`,
`keycloak` and `dependency-track` to Cloudflare R2 (bucket in `helm-charts/environment.yaml`): the Kubernetes objects go
into a tarball, the **volume data** is copied file by file by the **node-agent with Kopia** (local-path has no
snapshots). Kopia keeps one repository per namespace (`<ns>-default-kopia`) and runs periodic maintenance Jobs.

**Healthy looks like:** last successful backup < 25 h old, last status *Success*, BSL *Available*, 0 failures and
partial failures, enqueue = dequeue on the node-agent, maintenance succeeding.

**When something is red:** `velero backup get` / `velero backup describe <name> --details` and
`velero backup logs <name>` (or `kubectl --context k8s01 -n velero get backups,podvolumebackups`);
BSL unavailable → R2 credentials (`scripts/vault.sh`, key `homelab/velero`) or the endpoint in the Argo CD render env.
Alerts in this repo: `VeleroBackupFailed`, `VeleroBackupStale` (36 h). Note: Velero counters restart from 0 when the
Velero Pod restarts; the *last successful* timestamp is rebuilt from the existing Backup objects on startup.

panels.title: Active alerts for this service
panels.description: Prometheus alerts of this service that are FIRING (condition true for longer than the rule's `for`) or PENDING (condition true, waiting for `for`). Same filter as the red alert annotations of this dashboard; Watchdog/InfoInhibitor are excluded. Empty = healthy. Alertmanager has no receiver in this lab, so dashboards are where alerts are seen: the rule, its threshold and source are in the rule files (helm-charts/<app>/**/prometheus.rules.yaml or the -raw release) and in docs/dashboards/. All alerts of the lab: dashboard "Alerts overview" (Observability folder).

panels.title: Last successful backup age (per schedule)
panels.description: Time since the last successful backup of each schedule. Green < 25 h (one daily run plus margin), red from 36 h (alert VeleroBackupStale). Empty until the schedule has completed its first backup. Source: helm-charts/velero/velero/values.yaml.gotmpl (metrics.prometheusRule); https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/16829 (revision 5).

panels.title: Last successful backup age (any)
panels.description: Time since the last successful backup of any kind (scheduled or manual, e.g. the smoke tests run by hand). Source: https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero/blob/v1.18.2/pkg/metrics/metrics.go.

panels.title: Last backup status
panels.description: Result of the most recent backup per schedule (Velero: 1 = success, 0 = failure, partial failure counts as failure). Caveat from the Velero source: the value is initialised to 1 when the Velero Pod starts, before the schedule ever ran — always read it together with the age panel on the left. Source: https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero/blob/v1.18.2/pkg/metrics/metrics.go; https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/16829 (revision 5).

panels.title: Storage location (R2)
panels.description: Availability of each BackupStorageLocation as validated by Velero (1 = available). Unavailable = no backup can be written or read (credentials, endpoint, bucket). Source: https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero/blob/v1.18.2/pkg/metrics/metrics.go.

panels.title: Failed backups (7d)
panels.description: Backups that failed, partially failed or failed validation in the last 7 days (since the Velero Pod started if more recent). Source: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/16829 (revision 5); helm-charts/velero/velero/values.yaml.gotmpl (metrics.prometheusRule).

panels.title: Backups stored
panels.description: Backup objects that currently exist (expired ones are deleted after the 30-day TTL, so a daily schedule settles around 30). Source: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/16829 (revision 5).

panels.title: Backup results per day
panels.description: Backups by result per day: success, partial failure, failure, validation failure. A daily schedule should show one green bar per day. Source: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/16829 (revision 5). Derived query: increase over 1d instead of the upstream 1h buckets (one run per day).

panels.title: Backup duration (average per day)
panels.description: Average time a backup of each schedule took (objects + Kopia volume copy). A sudden jump means much more data changed or R2 got slow. Source: https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero/blob/v1.18.2/pkg/metrics/metrics.go. Derived query: increase(velero_backup_duration_seconds_sum[1d]) / increase(velero_backup_duration_seconds_count[1d]) — mean of the histogram over one day.

panels.title: Items backed up / item errors
panels.description: Kubernetes objects in the last backup per schedule and the errors hit while backing them up (an item error turns the backup into PartiallyFailed). Source: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/16829 (revision 5).

panels.title: Backups with warnings
panels.description: Backups that finished with warnings per day (e.g. a resource that could not be fetched, or a volume skipped). Warnings do not fail the backup; read them with `velero backup describe`. Source: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/16829 (revision 5).

panels.title: Backup tarball size
panels.description: Size of the backup tarball per schedule — **Kubernetes objects only**. Volume data copied by Kopia is not included (no Velero metric reports it; see `kubectl -n velero get podvolumebackups`). Source: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/16829 (revision 5); https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero/blob/v1.18.2/pkg/metrics/metrics.go.

panels.title: File-system backups queued vs finished
panels.description: PodVolumeBackups the node-agent accepted (enqueued) and finished (dequeued) per hour. Every volume of every backed-up Pod is one item. Enqueued without dequeued = a volume copy is stuck. Source: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/16829 (revision 5).

panels.title: Volume copies in flight
panels.description: Enqueued minus dequeued PodVolumeBackups since the node-agent started. Should drop back to 0 after each backup. Source: https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero/blob/v1.18.2/pkg/metrics/metrics.go. Derived query: enqueue_count - dequeue_count.

panels.title: Volume copy time (last run)
panels.description: Time the node-agent took for each volume copy of recent backups (PodVolumeBackup name, backup name). Pending: the gauge appears after the first file-system backup handled by the current node-agent Pod (next run of the schedule). Source: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/16829 (revision 5); https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero/blob/v1.18.2/pkg/metrics/metrics.go.

panels.title: Maintenance jobs per repository
panels.description: Kopia repository maintenance Jobs per repository (one per backed-up namespace), succeeded vs failed per day. Failed maintenance lets the repository grow (deleted snapshots are not garbage-collected). The failure counter only appears after the first failure. Source: https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero/blob/v1.18.2/pkg/metrics/metrics.go.

panels.title: Maintenance duration (average)
panels.description: Average duration of the maintenance Jobs per repository over the last day. Source: https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/velero/blob/v1.18.2/pkg/metrics/metrics.go. Derived query: increase(_sum[1d]) / increase(_count[1d]).

panels.title: Restores
panels.description: Restore operations by result per day. Restores only happen when someone runs `velero restore create` (recovery or a restore test). Source: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/16829 (revision 5).

panels.title: Backup deletions
panels.description: Backups deleted per day (TTL expiry after 30 days, or manual), by result. Failed deletions leave data in R2 that you keep paying for. Source: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/16829 (revision 5).

panels.title: Memory working set vs limit
panels.description: Memory of the Velero server and the node-agent (solid) and their limits (dashed). The node-agent peaks during the Kopia upload. Source: https://github.com/kubernetes-monitoring/kubernetes-mixin.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU cores used by the Velero server, node-agent and maintenance Jobs. Source: https://github.com/kubernetes-monitoring/kubernetes-mixin.
